synth.notes:
Counter: loses 1px on odd calls only (w=64-(n+1)//2). That explains the counter A5 mixed outcome (A5 at calls 11/17 decrements, at 10/42/66 it does not), so no field of the object itself decides it. n is hidden: it is tracked under the continuity gate, with fallback n=0 if w==64 else 2(64-w)-1.
Step-43 counterexample: the ghost is the player trail 2 moves behind. A5 record resets the trail to [level start (20,8), spawn (14,8)], so the first ghost after a record sits on the player and is not extracted (wall keeps index 7).
Player moves 6. Moves are blocked by the board/HUD band (y<8) and by any wall px in the destination box, except a box holding the plate centre. The first input of a fresh level (w=64) is a no-op.
Wall/rope: plate (topmost 3x3) covered by player or ghost -> arm/key left of the column slides +6 toward it. Wall px under layer-1 boxes are cropped. Names are type_{list index:03d}.
A5: if the player is on spawn it does nothing; in ghost mode it clears; otherwise it records
